title: datura stramonium inermis
intro: Datura stramonium inermis, commonly known as the prickly bittersweet nightshade, is a subspecies of the deadly nightshade plant. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of D. stramonium inermis include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in alleviating pain and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, such as scopolamine and atropine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
